tools.name: root_hunter
tools.description: Identifies related root domains for a target organization.

tools.name: sub_enumer
tools.description: Performs passive subdomain enumeration using public sources.

tools.name: sub_bforcer
tools.description: Performs active subdomain brute-forcing using wordlists.

tools.name: sub_permuter
tools.description: Generates and resolves subdomain mutations (e.g., dev-api from api).

target.description: The base domain or file of subdomains

tools.name: sub_checker
tools.description: Validates which subdomains are active (DNS Resolution).

tools.name: tech_detector
tools.description: Fingerprints technology stacks (Wappalyzer) on live endpoints.

target.description: The domain or URL to fingerprint

tools.name: sub_crawler
tools.description: Crawls the web application to discover endpoints and assets.

tools.name: js_analyzer
tools.description: Downloads and analyzes JavaScript files for secrets.

tools.name: link_analyzer
tools.description: Filters and patterns matches parameters for vulnerabilities.

tools.name: git_hunter
tools.description: Scans for exposed .git directories and sensitive source code leaks.

tools.name: param_reflector
tools.description: actively probes parameters for reflection (XSS/SSTI potential).
